# Sunrise Plumbing

> Sunrise Plumbing is a locally owned, licensed plumbing company in Austin, Texas, founded in 2009 by Texas Master Plumber Marcus Rivera. Phones are answered 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, with no extra charge for nights, weekends or holidays. Emergency calls in the Austin metro average about 45 minutes from call to arrival.

## Key facts

- Phone (24/7): (512) 555-0100
- Email: info@sunriseplumbing.com
- Office: 123 Main Street, Austin, TX 78701 (office hours Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 6 p.m.; phones answered 24/7)
- License: Texas Master Plumber License M-00000, issued by the Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners
- Insurance: $2 million general liability plus workers' compensation
- Warranty: 1 year on labor
- Pricing: flat-rate, quoted before work starts; free estimates on scheduled work
- Financing: available on jobs over $1,000 through a third-party lender, subject to credit approval
- Team: 12 licensed plumbers, 8 service trucks
- Service area: Austin, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Leander, Kyle, Buda, Manor, Lakeway (Texas)

## Services and typical prices

- [Emergency plumbing](https://sunriseplumbing.com/emergency-plumbing.html): Call (512) 555-0100 any time. A licensed plumber answers, and for emergencies we’re usually at your door in under an hour. Nights, weekends and holidays cost the same as a weekday. Typical prices: After-hours, weekend or holiday call: $0 extra; Stop the leak and make it safe (temporary repair): $150 to $300; Burst pipe repair, easy to reach: $250 to $650.
- [Water heater repair and replacement](https://sunriseplumbing.com/water-heater-repair.html): Most water heater repairs cost $150 to $350. Most tank replacements are done the same day for $1,400 to $2,600 installed. We work on tank and tankless, gas and electric, and every major brand. Typical prices: Diagnose and repair (thermostat, element or valve): $150 to $350; Tank flush and anode rod check: $125 to $175; 40 to 50 gallon electric tank, installed: $1,400 to $2,300.
- [Drain cleaning](https://sunriseplumbing.com/drain-cleaning.html): Clearing one clogged sink, tub or shower drain usually costs $125 to $250. If several drains are slow at once, the problem is likely in the main line, and we’ll clear it and run a camera to find the cause. Typical prices: Sink, tub or shower drain: $125 to $250; Toilet clog: $125 to $225; Main sewer line, cable machine: $225 to $450.
- [Pipe repair and repiping](https://sunriseplumbing.com/pipe-repair.html): Fixing a single leak that’s easy to reach usually costs $200 to $600. If your house has old galvanized or polybutylene pipe and the leaks keep coming, repiping in PEX typically runs $4,500 to $12,000, depending on size. Typical prices: Leak repair, easy to reach: $200 to $600; Burst pipe repair inside a wall (drywall extra): $400 to $900; Pressure reducing valve replacement: $350 to $650.
- [Leak detection and slab leaks](https://sunriseplumbing.com/leak-detection.html): Leak detection usually costs $200 to $450. We use acoustic listening gear and thermal cameras to find the leak before we cut anything, so you get one small opening instead of a torn-up floor. Typical prices: Leak detection visit: $200 to $450; Spot repair through the slab: $1,800 to $4,500; Reroute a hot or cold water line: $1,500 to $4,000.
- [Bathroom plumbing](https://sunriseplumbing.com/bathroom-plumbing.html): Most bathroom repairs, like a running toilet or a dripping faucet, cost $125 to $375. We also replace toilets and shower valves and handle the plumbing for bathroom remodels. Typical prices: Running or leaking toilet repair: $125 to $275; Toilet replacement, labor only: $250 to $450; Faucet replacement, labor only: $175 to $375.
- [Kitchen plumbing](https://sunriseplumbing.com/kitchen-plumbing.html): Most kitchen jobs, like a new faucet, a disposal or a dishwasher hookup, cost $150 to $500. We fix leaks under the sink too, and we’ll tell you when a repair makes more sense than a replacement. Typical prices: Garbage disposal installed (1/2 HP): $275 to $500; Kitchen faucet replacement, labor only: $175 to $375; Dishwasher hookup: $150 to $300.
- [Sewer line service](https://sunriseplumbing.com/sewer-line.html): A sewer camera inspection costs $175 to $300 and shows exactly what’s wrong before you spend money on a repair. Most problems we find are roots, grease or a sagging section, and many can be fixed without digging up the yard. Typical prices: Camera inspection with video: $175 to $300; Root cutting, main line: $250 to $500; Hydro-jetting, main line: $450 to $800.
